question: Who was the founder of the Mizo National Front (MNF)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Laldenga**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Laldenga **was a **Mizo nationalist **and **politician **from **Mizoram **in **northeast India**.
 
• He was the **founder **of the **Mizo National Front**, a **social organization **turned **political party**.
 
• He was the **first Chief Minister of Mizoram**, the office of which he **held from 1986 to 1988**.
 
• The **Mizo National Front **is a **regional political party **in **Mizoram, India**.
 
• **MNF emerged **from the **Mizo National Famine Front**, which was formed by **Pu Laldenga **to **protest against **the inaction of the Indian **central government **towards the **famine situation **in the **Mizo areas **of the **Assam state in 1959**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dr. F. Lalnunmawia **is a **Mizo National Front politician **from **Mizoram **and **resides at Samtlang, Aizawl**, **Mizoram**. He has been elected to the **Mizoram Legislative Assembly **from **Aizawl South 3 Constituency**.
 
• 
 
**Khuangchera **was no **“Indian” freedom fighter**. There is **no evidence **that he had any **fraternal feelings towards “mainland**” brown people or wanted the Zo country to be ruled by a New Delhi-based Brown administration.
